title: Measuring the Authority Stack of AI Systems: Empirical Analysis of 366,120 Forced-Choice Responses Across 8 AI Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI model priorities among Schwartz's 10 Basic Human Values (e.g., Universalism vs. Security) using a forced-choice scenario generation benchmark across multiple professional domains and contextual conditions.
Measuring model preferences for different types of evidence (e.g., empirical-scientific vs. pattern-experiential) via forced-choice prompts to identify systemic evaluation orientations.
Assessing AI model hierarchies of trust for various information sources (e.g., government bodies, academic journals, anonymous crowdsourcing) using structured forced-choice dilemmas.
Measuring the consistency of model choices across structurally identical but narratively varied scenario variants using Paired Consistency Scores (PCS) to detect sensitivity to narrative wrapping.
